profile.headline: Software Engineer at 7Factor
profile.summary: Full-stack developer with 6 years of experience developing software applications. Proficient with React.js, Vue.js, Golang (Go), Rust, Node.js, TypeScript, and databases like Neo4j, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL. Experienced self-starter, team player, and leader.

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
Help design, develop, test, and maintain both the main front-end React.js web application, and back-end communication services
Write tests alongside coworkers, for stable production and development, using tools like Jest and Cypress
Complete tasks alongside coworkers in an Agile environment
Secure health of endpoints and data using Joi validation alongside data health-checks in core services
Wrote core internal types and validation library for Node.js/React.js using TypeScript and Joi
Rewrote an outdated frontend React.js application to a React.js, TypeScript, Mobx, and TailwindCSS application
 Work alongside CTO to develop and scale services using Kubernetes and Docker alongside bitbucket pipelines

positions.title: Full stack web developer I
positions.description:
Built PUT, POST, GET, & DELETE endpoints for a Golang httprouter web server
Wrote unit and integration tests using Golang's built in testing service
Programmed charts and graphs using tools like d3, canvas, and vanilla svg's
Moved AngularJS application to a Vue 2.0 web application for use in an interactive analyitics dashboard
Built Reporting dashboard using Material UI and React.js
Developed a simple ORM for a custom NoSQL key-value/graph database
